Findings: (A) the classical selection among ties is exempt from the measure only for ties and incomparability and escapes exclusion as a real determination only on the open extrinsic-decree account, onto which the classical side's own requirement-form premises force it (same price as lane E's, counted once; an extra commitment only the personal side pays); in the no-best case a value-tracking root, personal or axiarchic, selects against its own favouring. The measure question reduces to how the standard of favouring is fixed (common value, common D, or per kind of operation, where it turns on whether a root's favouring is a natural or a rational appetite, the crux shared with premise lane C); e2357adc's warrant relocates to 'a common value standard governs a root's favouring' plus variation, sharp form 'a root's pure favouring makes exactly value's verdicts', strictly stronger than ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2; parity in form. (B) The unrestricted enumerative rule fails the reference-class test; the constitutive support relocates to a restricted (possible-intellect or causal-content) criterion; parity stands. (C) Conditional: no conflict under the tenseless reading (B-theory); under the A-theory the candidate stands against 0c8631bd or the purity of immutability unless the restated bridge (a determination whose possession entails successive first-order states involves potency) holds, which the A-theorist denies; it does not reach self-apprehension. (D) No derivation of composition from two favourings; in the row-7 family denying 3e6ae3e7 costs the noncognitive rival the criterion or E, with other options (deny ee287fd3 for good-generality, or joint compossibility) outside it. Rejected approaches: value-free refinement (condemns both disputed profiles); co-determinate criterion (decided by 3e6ae3e7 itself); variation among known instances (cannot exempt finitude); the de se analogy for de nunc knowledge (disanalogous: 'it is now t' is available to every knower at t). current_assessment.scope: Whether restriction of favouring content is a limitation (symmetric criterion, applied to the classical choice-specification); the reception fork as a reference-class test; immutability versus tensed knowing; one favouring per source
current_assessment.assessment: e2357adc remains open; its warrant relocates to 'a common value standard governs a root's favouring' plus goodness variation within a D-class (sharp form: a root's pure favouring makes exactly value's verdicts, strictly stronger than ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2); with a common end-realization standard the D-nature is unrestricted; on the per-bearer rule (the standard is the formal object of the bearer's kind of operation) the verdict turns on whether a root's favouring is a natural appetite (object D, unrestricted) or a rational appetite (object the good, restricted given variation), the crux where premise lanes C and P converge; parity in form. The classical selection among ties is exempt from the measure only for ties and incomparability and escapes exclusion as a real determination only on the open extrinsic-decree account, which the classical side's own requirement-form premises (not the restriction principle) force on it; same price as lane E's, counted once. In the no-best case a value-tracking root, personal or axiarchic, selects against its own favouring. da9f2d3c is a conditional alternative formulation of horn A's conclusion inside the purity family, sharing e2357adc's rationale and absorbing 3e6ae3e7's bearer-level uniqueness; it adds no independent warrant. 44e39691: parity on the reception fork; the unrestricted enumerative rule fails, the constitutive support relocates to a restricted criterion. 3e6ae3e7: no derivation as stated; in the row-7 family its denial costs the noncognitive rival the criterion or E. The immutability candidate is conditional on the A-theory and the restated bridge and does not reach self-apprehension. No premise is established.
